name: Adaalat
description: K.D Pathak is a suave, sophisticated, witty and yet unconventional defence lawyer with an impeccable track record. He stands not for his client, but for Justice.

videos.title: Superstar Ki Hatya
videos.overview: A producer Dhiren Shah is upset with Superstar Rehan Khan. Rehan Khan is shot by Dhiren Shah. Maya, a lawyer is sure that she will win the case as he is in custody and the evidence is clear. But KD aims to uncover the rumours and find the truth. Can KD win the open and shut case?

videos.title: Bank Mein Chori
videos.overview: Namdev works as a clerk in a bank and was given an amount but he was robbed by a person. The witness to the crime is dead. Namdev loses his job at the bank. Will K.D. Pathak help Namdev to get his job back with dignity?

videos.title: C.I.D. Officer Abhijeet Adaalat Mein
videos.overview: Inspector Abhijeet is arrested for killing Gangster Zoravar. CID is asked not to interfere. K.D. Pathak comes in to help with a solution. He believes there is a twist in the tale. Will K.D. Pathak succeeded in saving senior CID officer Abhijeet?

videos.title: Neend Ki Bimari Ya Qatl Ka Bahana
videos.overview: Nirmal Madhok gets killed. He owns a resort with Arjun and his third partner Kailash. Kailash demands for 50% share and Nirmal isn’t okay with it. Arjun is blamed for it. What will K.D. Pathak do to save Arjun?

videos.title: Jaadugar Ki Khooni Talwar
videos.overview: In a magic show, Lucy the assistant of Magician Marco gets killed with a real sword. Everyone is baffled by it. The other two assistants Sapna and Jagat were present in the audience while this was happening and so was Magician Gogo present in the audience. KD has to save Marco, will he be able to?

videos.title: K. D. Ki Jung Supreme Court Mein
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak has a case against the Supreme Court regarding the bomb blast in Sunshine's old age home. He has only 36 hours to prove that the accused, Nooruddin is innocent. Will he win the case?

videos.title: Qatl Ka Khel
videos.overview: In a badminton court, Devindar Sodhi the coach of Sonali Baruah, gets killed. Sonali is taken into custody but doesn't want KD to fight her case. How will this case turn out to be?

videos.title: Mukhyamantri Ka Qatil Kaun
videos.overview: Jagan is unemployed so Chandu's friend gives him work. He gives him the idea of robbing the bungalow that belongs to the Chief Minister Niranjan Sahai who gets killed and the entire blame is on Chandu. Will K.D. Pathak save Chandu from this crime?

videos.title: Jhooth Ka Sach
videos.overview: In Stockholm Scam, there were many personalities involved. There were politicians, government officials and other dignitaries. This information is known to Swami Agnidev. He gets killed in a room filled with five people and Trishika is the one found near the body. KD Pathak has a task in hand to save Trishika, will he do what it takes?

videos.title: Wafaadar Kutte Tintin Ka Bayaan
videos.overview: In a case, Major Shantanu Roy is arrested for the murder of Richard Lobo. The case escalates as a strong defence lawyer has evidence against Shantanu. What will K.D Pathak do now?

videos.title: Circus Mein Qatil Kaun
videos.overview: In Ringo Circus, Madan's uncle blackmails people. Dolly, Akbar, Babloo, and Zabisco all were upset with him. They fear losing their jobs due to Madan. The owner of the circus, Madan gets killed and Babloo is the only suspect. Will KD be able to save Babloo?

videos.title: Qatil Aatma Adaalat Mein
videos.overview: A haveli is being converted by Subir and his friend business partner Vikas to a 5-star hotel. There is a rumour that there is a ghost, Ghost Amrapali who is very dangerous and gets killed. Who killed him?

videos.title: Qatil Pyaar
videos.overview: Valentine’s Day is being celebrated in a club. Manav Karla organised it and invites his friends, Varsha, Vikram, Riya, and Mukul. There is a problem within, where poison is mixed in the drink. People in the club suspect Varsha. Will KD help her out in the case?

videos.title: Qatil Boxer
videos.overview: In a boxing match, two rivals are onto each other punching. It is Tejas Yadav versus Dharam Kumar. Lavanya bets on Dharam Kumar instead of her boyfriend. But in the ring, Tejas Yadav gets killed. It seems that there were nails used in the gloves. How will KD get down to the case?

videos.title: Theatre Mein Qatl
videos.overview: While watching a film in a theatre, Deepa is shot. No one knows how, who and why. KD Pathak is up against little to no clues to close the case. How will he do it?

videos.title: Giant Wheel Par Qatl
videos.overview: Bandiya fears for his life as he is supposed to share important information with Inspector Vishwanath Rana in regard to a big racket of drugs. He wants to be on the Giant Wheel. But gets killed Rana is the suspect. Will K.D.Pathak save Rana?

videos.title: K. D. Pathak Zinda Dafan
videos.overview: Standing in the graveyard, Flabia Gomes is sad looking at her Aunt Cynthia Gomes's grave. She finds a big crack on the tombstone and urges the people to dig her out. She is shocked by the sight of it. She finds her husband Mario's body was buried. K.D. Pathak receives a call from an unknown person not to fight this case. Will KD Pathak take up the case?

videos.title: 345 Kilo Ka Qatil
videos.overview: Prince Rudy Singh Dhanora's ex-girlfriend, Sharmila Rathore gets killed in her mansion. Everyone including the investigation officer is questioned in the court of law. Prince Rudy attends the session from home due to being overweight. How will KD solve the case?

videos.title: Gumnaam Qatil
videos.overview: The flight of K.D. Pathak is delayed. A new flight is sent by J.K. Singhal the founder of Singhal group of companies. In the flight, the Pilot and Writer et killed. The doubt of murder comes on Sheetal as she was present all the time near the murder. Will K.D. Pathak save her friend Sheetal?

videos.title: K. D. Pathak Jail Mein
videos.overview: Dilawar Singh is to be hung. But before hanging someone mixes poison in his dinner. The whole blame comes from chef Chandan Singh. Chandan's teacher Surbhi takes help from K.D Pathak. K.D. reaches jail to find out the actual reason. Will he save Chandan Singh?

videos.title: Lift Mein Qatl
videos.overview: In a lift, Mukul Bhagat along with his brother Sanjay and 5 others are moving up. Mukul Bhagat gets killed with a screwdriver in the lift. All the scrutiny goes on his brother. Will KD settle the case?

videos.title: Qatil Murti
videos.overview: The owner of the art gallery gets murdered. The blame goes on the sculptor, Amrit Nagpal. KD Pathak has a case in hand where he has to save poor Amrit Nagpal. How will KD help him through?

videos.title: Iqbal-E-Jurm
videos.overview: In a series of events, a famous photographer Jagtap Tiwari gets killed. In retaliation, Father Martin gets arrested. The famous Bharatnatyam Dancer comes to KD to seek help. How will KD get hold of the case?

videos.title: Begunaah Ghode Ka Kissa
videos.overview: In a racing sport, Shalimar, a horse owned by Thapar loses in it. He orders the stable boy, Charan to kill it. He later even hurts the jockey, Cyrus Dastur. His maid and daughter stop him not to hurt the horse, but he doesn't listen to them. KD Pathak must help Shalimar.

videos.title: Jalpari
videos.overview: Madhukar Vaidy is a businessman who deals with fish for a living. He isn't a nice man to work with. At a clinic, two women encounter each other. They happen to be the wives of the same man, Madhukar. He gets killed on a boat named Jalpari. One of the wives is accused, will KD help her out?

videos.title: Raaton Ka Raja Saamri
videos.overview: While shooting for a TV show, a co-actor is dead. Vaibhavi gets killed by a vampire and "The Great Saamri" is arrested for the crime. KD Pathak has a tough case in hand, will he be able to solve the case?

videos.title: Kissa Don Ke Khoon Ka
videos.overview: The accused in this case is all doomed. The case is open and shut and the prosecution won't leave anything behind. KD has a heavy task in hand and tries to solve the case in the best possible manner.

videos.title: Flat Mein Qatl
videos.overview: A doctor gets killed in his house next to his fiancé. She seeks KD's help. There are various angles to look at the case. Prior to the death, there was a fight with a neighbour and a witness still lives, who happens to be a thief. How will KD manage the case?

videos.title: Kissa Builder Ke Qatl Ka
videos.overview: While running a marathon, Rohan Madwa gets arrested. He is accused of killing his girlfriend, Sheena. Things go out of control, as Sunidhi one of Rohan's seeks KD's help in the case. How will KD be able to save Rohan?

videos.title: Kissa Builder Ke Qatl Ka
videos.overview: On a construction site, Captain Saroj Modakh fights with his best friend Prem Bharadwaj. Prem dies falling from the building. Captain Saro has a reason it seems. Is Prem's murder an accident or a murder?

videos.title: K. D. VS K. D.  Part 1
videos.overview: This is the most thrilling episode where there is a twin of K.D Pathak committing crimes

videos.title: K. D. VS K. D.  Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak is in jail for the murder. Nothing seems to work for him at this point in time. But help comes walking, that is, Ranawat. Something seems off in the case. They find shocking details of the case. Will KD come out of jail?

videos.title: Maut Ka Pyaala
videos.overview: A lot goes into committing a crime. But a crime where a woman named Mahulya dies after drinking tea at home. KD has a task in hand, to find the killer and to bring justice to the family. Will the family get justice?

videos.title: Samundar Mein Khoon
videos.overview: Two divers named, Ramakant and Parag were sent underwater to see what was stuck. They find a net that is stuck underwater. But Parag dies and the whole blame goes on Ramakant. Will KD Pathak solve the case?

videos.title: Raaz Angry Colonel Ke Khoon Ka
videos.overview: There is a whooping property of 90 crore rupees for Koyal with her uncle Rt. Col. Manek Dhanrajgir is the official caretaker. The Colonel refuses to give money to Koyal as she has not completed 25 years and then the Colonel gets killed. Who killed Rt.Col. Manek Dhanrajgir?

videos.title: Super Model Ki Hatya Ka Kissa
videos.overview: A Supermodel Neharika is dead. All the suspicion goes to Darji Saleem, as a trophy is found that belongs to Neharika. Darji Saleem is arrested. Is he the murderer?

videos.title: Qatil Kaun Part 1
videos.overview: While having a debate on the National Television channel, a fight breaks out. There is a call threatening Rajat Roy the host of the show. He gets fatally shot in the abdominal area. Before dying, Rajat Roy mentions Raghuveer's name, and everyone thinks that Raghuveer is the one who shot Rajat Roy. Is he the real killer?

videos.title: Qatil Kaun Part 2
videos.overview: The case continues as there is another murder. KD Pathak is up against a dreadful killer. He has to figure out what is happening. Will things fall in place for him to investigate?

videos.title: Khoon Ki Dastak
videos.overview: Urja Seth a psychic who is accused of killing Sonal. She doesn’t understand why she is being accused. She seeks help from KD. Will KD help her out?

videos.title: Khoon Ka Rishta
videos.overview: A jeweller is dead in his shop, lying on his desk. All the jewellery is missing too. The cops arrest the front desk woman. KD feels to be different. Will KD crack the case?

videos.title: K. D. Pathak Ko Chunauti
videos.overview: A man with a gun walks into KD's office. He wants KD to save a girl who will be murdered. The killer challenges him to save her. KD fails to do so. What will KD's fate be like?

videos.title: Kissa Hostel Suicide Ka
videos.overview: A case confuses everyone, where a girl leaves a suicide note and is dead. A professor is arrested on the basis of accusations. KD thinks the professor is innocent. Will KD prove his innocence?

videos.title: Pyaar Ke Naam Qatl-E-Aam
videos.overview: An actress gets killed by her boyfriend. This is what everyone seems to claim. Her boyfriend is an Underworld Don. He seeks help from KD Pathak. Will KD Pathak help the Underworld Don?

videos.title: Murdaghar Khoon Ka Raaz
videos.overview: In one case, a nurse, Varsha is heading towards the morgue with a dead body when she hears noises. She seems scared but the next moment, photojournalist Pranav is dead. Who killed him and why?

videos.title: Kissa Qatil Shekhar Ka
videos.overview: Ria gets arrested in the murder of her husband Saahil. Ria puts the blame for her husband's death on his close friend Shekhar. Security guard Govind discloses that he never saw Shekhar on the premises. Ria claims that he was in Chennai but the evidence proves that he was in the building. Who killed Saahil?

videos.title: Comedian Ya Qatil
videos.overview: In a strange series of events, comedian Aarti Sinha is angry with  Mr Kishen Chawla who refuses to pay. She to have picked up the scissor but she didn't kill him. Who killed Mr Chawla? Will K.D.Pathak save Comedian Aarti Sinha?

videos.title: Kissa C.M. Ki Secret List Ka Part 1
videos.overview: There was going to be a revelation with few names with evidence on 'Independence Day from the Chief Minister. These people were involved in the Nandrao land scam. Shooter Makhan kills Journalist Bryan Parreira during a press conference. Shooter Makhan called CM on his cell phone before shooting Bryan and thus CM Rao gets arrested. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in saving the Chief Minister of India?

videos.title: Kissa C.M. Ki Secret List Ka Part 2
videos.overview: All the evidence is collected by K.D. Pathak. He visits the CM's office. K.D. briefly collects information about CM and inquiries about his daily routine. Will he be able to prove him innocent?

videos.title: Masoom Gawah Part 1
videos.overview: Paras is a child who has seen his mother, Sudha being killed. The boy's nanny Maria has been arrested. Paras also draws a picture of the lady who resembles the nanny. KD Pathak has a task in hand to save the nanny. Will he be able to?

videos.title: Masoom Gawah Part 2
videos.overview: There is an attempt to kill Paras. He is safe in KD's office. Inspector Dave finds a truck in the middle of the forest. They find a dead body in it. How will KD Pathak solve the case?

videos.title: Letter Bomb Murder
videos.overview: A murder takes place, where Rachana Bhasin gets killed. The blame goes on Munshi Shyamchand Srivastava. He is the senior-most employee in her Father's firm. He was also handed over 100 crores. Will KD Pathak be able to save Munshi?

videos.title: Chashmadeed Gawah Tota
videos.overview: KD Pathak is up against a fortune-telling parrot. Usha Mishra visits K.D.Pathak's office and tell him that her daughter Geeta Mishra will be arrested in the murder of her stepfather Sanjay Madhok. The dead body was found in Sanjay's Lonavala farmhouse. Parrot reveals the truth in the court that Geeta murdered Sanjay. How will K.D. Pathak save Geeta?

videos.title: Kissa Taxi Murder Ka
videos.overview: Sanjay is found murdered in his house. The sole eyewitness in the case is a Parrot. Based on this, the police arrest Geeta, who is the prime suspect in the case. How will KD Pathak prove Geeta's innocence? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Shraddha 50
videos.overview: A Novelist gets arrested in the murder of Industrialist Arjun Kapoor's wife Megha. Her real name happens to be  Pooja. The Novelist Rajiv discloses to K.D.Pathak that Pooja wanted him to keep an eye on her husband and for that, she was ready to pay him 2 lakh rupees per month. WiIl K.D Pathak finds out the real killer of Pooja?

videos.title: Mystery Of The Alarm Clock
videos.overview: Ramnish the son-in-law of Dr Ashok Sandhu gets murdered. Ramnish's wife  Rashi expresses her doubts. Rashi and Dr Sandhu reveal to K.D Pathak that they haven't killed Ramnish. How will K.D. Pathak prove Dr Sandhu innocent?

videos.title: K. D. In Ahmedabad
videos.overview: Dakshaben's tiffin is extremely popular in Gujrat Ahemdabad. Khemmji bhai who is a jewellery owner was her regular client to whom she used to sent him food. It was Dakshaben's daily process of sending food to various clients. K.D.Pathak visits Ahemdabad. Thief Ghattu reveals his robbery to cops and also discloses that Dakshaben had send him to robb Kheemji bhai and also promised that she would divide the money. Will K.D. Pathak prove Dakshaben innocent? Who killed Kheemji bhai? Will he solve the puzzlee of real Ghee?

videos.title: Pyaar Ya Insaaf Part 1
videos.overview: A doctor gets killed in his clinic. A professor gets arrested for it. It is also informed that he was following the professor for 2 years. Will K.D Pathak save the professor?

videos.title: Pyaar Ya Insaaf Part 2
videos.overview: In this case, KD Pathak gets tensed about the professor who talks about poetry instead of the knife that is used. They find a harmonica in the body of the deceased. KD Pathak is also bound as he is kidnapped, not able to solve this case. What will happen now.

videos.title: Black Magic Murder Part 1
videos.overview: Dr Firdos Balsara visits K.D Pathak's office with a request to save his close friend Ankit Luthra who got trapped in a murder. Dr Balsara also reveals that Ankit is the murderer but during the murder, he was suffering from black magic and that black magic made him kill his Business Partner Kapadia. The court does not believe in black magic. How will K.D Pathak prove Ankit innocent?

videos.title: Black Magic Murder Part 2
videos.overview: Dr. Firdos Balsara attacks Ankit in the court with a knife. K.D.Pathak mentions the reason behind Dr. Balsra's act and reveals that he did not have any control over his mind and excatly same thing occured with Ankit. Varun records a solid proof. K.D.Pathak gets a shock when he see's the footage and also calls forensic doctor Rastogi who reveals that a substance was mixed in his water. Will Court believe K.D.Pathak? Who forced Ankit to kill Kapadia? What will K.D.Pathak do now?

videos.title: Double Death
videos.overview: K.D Pathak is shocked as his assistant Varun tells him that Dr Susheel Bharti called him. Dr Bharti has been dead for the past 3 years. Varun visits his clinic and informs her wife about the incident who later forces Varun to leave. Dr Bharti is already dead in a plane crash so how come his body is found in a Blue Pearl cottage. How will KD solve the case?

videos.title: Jhoota Qatil
videos.overview: Inspector Dave arrests famous Builder Wadhwa's son Rahul Wadhwa for killing Siddhant Rastogi but Rahul denies the accusations. K.D.Pathak gets shocked in the court as all the witnesses change their statement in the court. Will K.D.Pathak prove Rahul Innocent? Who killed Siddhant Rastogi?

videos.title: Ramleela Mein Qatl
videos.overview: During the Ramleela play Vimal as Ravan gets killed by Diwakar as Ram with a pointed arrow. Diwakar's girlfriend and Vimal's sister Varsha is shocked as she gets to know that his brother is dead. Director Vijay who has been directing Ramleela for 7 years reveals that he was not good at shooting arrows and also reveals that Vimal was not at all happy with Varsha and Diwakar's affair. Will K.D.Pathak save Diwakar?

videos.title: Qatil Dandiya Night
videos.overview: It is the night of Navratri where everyone is playing Dandiya. But someone is up to something not so auspicious. There is the murder that takes place. A girl dies and points her finger towards the suspect. But things are not as easy as they seem to be. KD Pathak has a task in hand, to solve the case with earnest.

videos.title: Raaz Chauthe Chor Ka
videos.overview: Three robbers try to rob a bank. The next day, a robber gets killed. The whole blame goes onto an old man who had nothing to do with the robbery. Will KD Pathak save the old man?

videos.title: Faraar
videos.overview: Rohan and Mukesh are in the midst of a deal with Harpal about the Crown which has a 50 crore price. Harpal wants that Crown at a small price but Mukesh denies it. When he reaches home, he gets killed. Who killed Rohan and why?

videos.title: Dave Hiraasat Mein Part 1
videos.overview: Inspector Dave arrests a weapon Smuggler named Manan who later dies in jail and the whole blame for Manan's murder comes on Inspector Dave as few constables and criminals saw Dave brutally beating Manan in the jail. Dave later informs K.D.Pathak but a big trouble arises as K.D.Pathak gets kidnapped just before the case hearing. Will K.D.Pathak succeeded in reaching on time?

videos.title: Dave Hiraasat Mein Part 2
videos.overview: Inspector Dave gets extremely upset as K.D.Pathak fails to reach on time to save him from the crime which he didn't do but he is completely unaware that K.D. is in trouble. Finally, the Judge reveals his final verdict for killing Weapon Smuggler Manan Srivastav but K.D. Pathak luckily manages to convince the Judge to delay the decision. Will he save Inspector Dave?

videos.title: Zindagi Milegi Dobara Part 1
videos.overview: A man named Rajiv is found dead in the church with a mangalsutra in his hand that belongs to his mother. Father Pinto informs this to the police and Rajiv's mother is blamed for the murder. But K.D thinks that she is not the killer. Who killed Rajiv?

videos.title: Zindagi Milegi Dobara Part 2
videos.overview: The case makes KD go back in past. A guy named Aaryan gives him a diary. The diary has many clues which makes the case interesting. KD Pathak is confused. The diary makes him go back to 1991. How will the case take a turn?

videos.title: Khoon Ka Jaal
videos.overview: A Brazilian wandering spider one of the most poisonous spiders escapes from its shelf as Lab assistant Sushmita accidentally keeps the shelf open. A diamond trader, Pushpesh Kanuja loses his life as a spider bites him. Mayur Panth chief accountant of Pushpesh's diamond trading company reveals that a massive argument took place between Dr Indar and Pushpesh in regards to a land dispute. Who killed Puspesh Kanuja?

videos.title: Tunnel Mein Khoon
videos.overview: Aarya gets arrested in the murder of her boyfriend Mehul who gets killed on the bus while travelling towards Pune with his friends. Mehul's death occurred due to a pastry which was offered by Aarya to Mehul while they were entering the tunnel. Mehul's best friend Ishan Gupta reveals that he has full trust in Aarya and that she can't kill him instead, he admits that he killed Mehul but does not have any idea about the poison. How did Poison appear on the pastry?

videos.title: Dohri Uljhan Part 1
videos.overview: A woman is murdered in her home and a painter who worked for her is arrested for it. His girlfriend who firmly believing in his innocence, goes to KD Pathak to ask for his help in proving his innocence. Watch how KD Pathak unravels the case to prove his innocence and find the real culprit.

videos.title: Dohri Uljhan Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak realizes the truth behind Anurag. As Virat taunts Pathak from the cell, he is in a dilemma as to whether save Anurag or help punish Virat. Watch how Pathak tackles this headache of a case.

videos.title: Waaris
videos.overview: Manohar sethiya a very rich man of the city was trying to find his lost grand daughter who will be the the heir of his property. Kavita and Deepika claims to be his grand daughter. After some days Manohar is found dead in his room. Kavita is accused for the murder. Will K.D. Pathak unfold the mystery of this case ?

videos.title: Kathputli Ka Khel Part 1
videos.overview: The new Programme head for a prominent channel gets murdered with his own showpiece dagger and the suspect is a ventriloquist who got his programme cancelled. Pathak takes on the case, believing in his innocence

videos.title: Kathputli Ka Khel Part 2
videos.overview: To save an innocent Shipra, KD Pathak loses the case. After saving her KD Pathak decides to take the case to the high court. How will KD Pathak prove the innocence of his client to the high court?

videos.title: Qatil Bawarchi
videos.overview: A chef named Vijay is arrested for allegedly murdering his co-worker. KD Pathak gets a call from a mysterious lady to take this case. KD Pathak goes to meet Vijay and decides to take the case into his hands. How will KD Pathak solve this case and prove Vijay's innocence?

videos.title: Khel Khel Mein
videos.overview: Thakur Ujjwal Singh's death from a snake bite leads to Neelakshi being accused of being an Ichadhari Nagin. KD Pathak defends her against baseless claims, but a twist occurs when Ujagar Singh dies from a snake bite, raising questions about Neelakshi's true identity. Is Neelakshi really the mythical shape-shifting cobra the villagers claim her to be? Watch and find out.

videos.title: Naagin Part 1
videos.overview: In the previous episode, Neelakshi, accused of being an Ichadhari Nagin, was found in the Haweli where Ujagar Singh died. During the court proceedings, a snake charmer named Bhairavnath spins a story about her past. KD Pathak exposes Bhairavnath as an actor paid to tell the tale. The mystery deepens as someone tries to frame Neelakshi, how will KD solve this superstitious tale and free Neelakshi of the murder charge?

videos.title: Naagin Part 2
videos.overview: K.D.Pathak shocked to see Nilakshi in the same Haveli where Thakur Ujagar Singh was killed but a major problem arises as Bhairav Baba reveals a real story to court that Nilakshi's mother was a snake whose 'Mani' was stolen from the Jungle by 2 young guys who were none other than Thakur Ujwal and Ujagar Singh, thus he plays an instrument due to which Nilakshi faints. Who killed Thakur Ujwal Singh and Thakur Ujagar Singh? Is Nilakshi Innocent?

videos.title: Blackmail
videos.overview: A therapist loses a tape containing the therapy session with one of his prominent clients that had a huge secret in it. Panic strikes him as he realizes that his career could be at stake and thus turns to Pathak to help him find it instead of the police.

videos.title: Qatil Biker Part 1
videos.overview: Faisal, a member of a biker group, is accused of causing Chirag's fatal bike accident due to an oil spill. Faisal's father asks KD for help stating innocence of his son, KD Pathak takes up Faisal's case. As the trial unfolds, Brando gets hit by a truck and implicates Faisal's involvement, raising doubts about the true culprit. The mystery of Chirag and Brando's deaths remains unsolved.

videos.title: Qatil Biker Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak argues that Brando's death was no accident but a premeditated murder. He uncovers crucial evidence linking Chanchal to Chirag's murder, and Yogi reveals his affair with Chanchal. Unfortunately, both Chanchal and Yogi are killed before revealing the killer's identity, leaving KD with a daunting challenge to prove Faisal's innocence in court, as all eyewitnesses are eliminated.

videos.title: Qatil Billi
videos.overview: A woman seems to take her anger out on a picture of a lady. A party has been hosted by Sweety. Police arrived in the party after getting information about drugs in the party. Everyone is angry on Sweety and she is being blamed for the party getting ruined. Sweety goes to meet Mistry for trying to ruining her party. Mistry is found dead in her home and she is arrested. Sweety shouts at K.D. Pathak for not letting her out on bail.

videos.title: Maut Ka Kuwa
videos.overview: KD Pathak takes on the challenging case of Sikander, accused of involvement in Toofan Singh's death during a dangerous car stunt. While facing his adversary, Inder Mohan Jaiswal, in court, Jaiswal claims that Toofan was drunk, but the troop's owner, Baljeet Singh, refutes this. As the case unfolds, it is revealed that Sikander had an affair with Baljeet's wife, Mohini. With all evidence pointing toward Sikander, KD decides to visit the murder scene one last time, which leads him toward the real culprit. Watch as KD Pathak uses his wit and instincts to find the man behind the murder of Toofan Singh.

videos.title: Qatil Drishti
videos.overview: Dhrishti is found with the murder weapon at the crime scene after foreseeing her friend Ira's murder. Niyati Sachdev takes on Dhrishti's defense, and KD Pathak's testimony initially seems to seal her fate. However, KD's revelation of a hallucinogenic drug plot reopens the case, leading to suspicions on Dhrishti's husband, Parth, her friend Navya, and Ira's fiancé, Yug. Watch KD raise the curtain on Ira's murderer and prove Dhrishti's innocence.

videos.title: Qatil Judi Huyi Judwaa Part 1
videos.overview: Mihika and Maya, who are conjoined twins, find themselves in a murder case involving their uncle, Mamaji, who was poisoned. In a surprising twist, Maya expresses her desire to undergo separation from her sister. When questioned, their mother, Tarika Sharma, admits to being the one responsible for killing her brother. Who murdered Mihika and Maya's Mamaji?

videos.title: Qatil Judi Huyi Judwaa Part 2
videos.overview: During the court proceedings, Tarika confesses to the murder of her brother, but a significant complication arises when the notes containing her confession get mixed up with other notes from the bed. Subsequently, it is discovered through fingerprint analysis that the incriminating prints actually belong to Jashn.

videos.title: Kissa Honour Killing Ka Part 1

His success rate of acquittals is 100 percent. But most importantly KD stands not for his client, but for Justice.

videos.title: Barfili Laash
videos.overview: A frozen dead body was found in Dhruv Dixit's House. The owner of the house, Dhruv Dixit gets arrested. Dhruv does not have any clue about the dead body. The dead body was of Suhasini Shinde who went missing 3 years ago. Suhasini's Father Rt. Manhoar Desai identifies her Daughter's dead body. K.D. Pathak questions Suhasini's Husband who reveals the name of her Wife's Boyfriend in the court. Who killed Suhasini? Will K.D. Pathak succeed in proving Dhruv innocent?

videos.title: Shraapit Tapoo Part 1
videos.overview: A businessman wants to build a resort on a distantg island that is said to be cursed, despite being warned. Meanwhile, a young couple on their way to the same island mysteriously disappear.Watch as K.D. solves the frightening mystery of this wicked, cursed island.

videos.title: Shraapit Tapoo Part 2
videos.overview: When K.D. Pathak learns that Varun also had a mishap while visiting the cursed island, he is taken aback. Varun is in critical condition. K.D. Pathak dazzles Swamiji in front of the magistrate. In addition to discussing the magnetic force, K.D. Pathak discloses a startling fact in court. Will K.D. Pathak solve the secrets of the enigmatic case of the cursed island?

videos.title: Qatil Jinn Part 1
videos.overview: Jin curses Maulana Rauf Ahmed Saab and his family for brutally killing Jin's Son in the jungle. All the Sons who took birth in Maulana Saab's Family got killed as his Family was cursed. One more member of Maulana Saab's Family Razaq gets killed and his Friend Saaqib gets arrested. Saaqib's Family members visit Mumbai to meet K.D. Pathak. Razaq reveals to K.D. Pathak that he saw Jin pushing Saaqib from the terrace. Rehan reveals the fight that took place between Saaqib and Razaq. How will K.D. Pathak prove Saaqib innocent? Did Jin kill Razaq?

videos.title: Qatil Jinn Part 2
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak comes across the Jinn in the jungle but before K.D. Pathak could reach out to him he vanishes. A jin tells Rehan and his Grandmother to reveal the truth in the court and also tells them to prove Saaqib innocent. Rehan's Family and Sana changes their statement and Rehan firmly decides to take his case back. Sana reveals a shocking truth in the court. Jin arrives in the court. Will Jin reveal the truth in the court? To find out, watch this thrilling episode of Adaalat.

videos.title: Qatil Daayan Part 1
videos.overview: Suspecting her to be a witch, a mob of angry villagers barge into Meenakshi's house and burn her alive. Later, Renu meets a gruesome death, which her father believes is due to Meenakshi's spirit. Later, the villagers apprehend Savithri, as they believe that she is possessed. KD Pathak learns about the incident from Varun Zaveri, his assistant. He reaches Jambulgaon and intervenes when the villagers decide to burn Savithri to death. KD dispels the lies and finds Renu's real murderer.

videos.title: Qatil Daayan Part 2
videos.overview: Varun, KD Pathak's assistant, is attacked and produced before the village council. Bahubali, one of the villagers, is enraged by KD Pathak and Varun, and asks them to leave. Later, KD Pathak questions Bahubali's wife, Mansi, about her visit to a black magician. She admits that she was performing a sacrificial ceremony in the belief that it will help her bear a child. But then, KD Pathak produces a doctor before the village council who reveals that shortly before her death, Meenakshi had visited her clinic to get an abortion, and that Meenakshi was pregnant with Bahubali's child!

videos.title: Manav Bhediya Part 1
videos.overview: Scientist who was conducting an experiment on Animals gets bitten by a Man Eater who was trapped in his cage. Social Activists for Animals, Sunanda Chatwal gets murdered by the Man Eater. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case on behalf of the Scientist. Will he be able to save the Scientist?

videos.title: Manav Bhediya Part 2
videos.overview: Professor Lahiri turns violent and attacks Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer. Inder uses this event to prove that Lahiri is a werewolf and he attacked and killed Sunanda Chatwal. However, KD Pathak claims in the court that Lahiri is mentally ill and needs medical treatment. Following the court’s order, Lahiri is admitted to a mental hospital. Subsequently, Lahiri goes missing from the hospital. KD Pathak suspects that Lahiri has been kidnapped by the real culprit. To make matters worse, Lahiri's wife, Neerja, is found murdered with scratch marks of an animal on her body.

videos.title: Anjaan K. D.  Part 1
videos.overview: KD Pathak regains consciousness and finds himself on a beach in Goa. KD has no memory of how he ended up at the beach and even fails to remember his name. Meanwhile, in a district court in Goa, the judge waits for the arrival of KD. Varun, KD's assistant, informs the judge that KD is not answering his phone. Varun requests the judge to wait a while longer. KD was earlier at a farm house, trying to gather some evidence for a murder case. Later, a sniper tries to kill KD. Before the sniper can find his target, Varun arrives at the spot with the police and takes KD home. Varun's tries in vain to help KD regain his memory. Then, Varun persuades KD to fight Alfred Rego’s case in the court.

videos.title: Anjaan K. D.  Part 2
videos.overview: Alfred Rego was allegedly in a meeting when George Rego was killed, according to KD Pathak's testimony in court. The prosecution's attorney, Rajnath Salgaonkar, refutes KD's assertions, claiming that Alfred organized George's murder and employed hitmen to carry out his scheme. As he searches for proof, KD remembers that the attackers brought him to Chapora. Next, KD and Varun stumble into another trap meant to murder KD. But KD makes it through and apprehends the hitman. The hitman is shot dead by an unidentified assailant before he can identify George's murderer. The hunt for the shooter is over for KD and Varun. Then, Savio Fonseca calls KD and says he has discovered an important clue regarding the case. When KD meets Savio, he pulls a gun to KD's head and reveals himself to be a killer.

videos.title: Qatil Patrakar Part 1
videos.overview: Saurabh, a journalist, is accused of murdering Rajesh. During the courtroom proceedings, KD Pathak claims that Rajesh was dead before the arrival of Saurabh. Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, claims that the fingerprints found on the murder weapon are of Saurabh's. Later, KD finds that Sanjana, Saurabh's wife, has kleptomania. He discovers that Sanjana stole a perfume bottle from a shop in which Rajesh was employed. Rajesh used the CCTV footage of the theft to blackmail Saurabh. Later, KD learns that Rupal, Saurabh's colleague, has been promoted. He reasons that Rupal benefited from Saurabh's downfall and suspects her involvement in the murder.

videos.title: Qatil Patrakar Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak learns that Rupal has been murdered. Sanjana suspects that the blackmailer has killed her. Later, the police apprehend Ashok, the blackmailer. Ashok informs KD that Rajesh was dead much before Saurabh's arrival. He claims that Saurabh and Rupal had an affair. When Inder Mohan Jaiswal hears this, he suspects that Saurabh murdered Rajesh to hide his affair with Rupal. After the court hearing concludes, Ashok is shot by an unidentified assailant. During the investigation, KD finds a vital clue which leads him to suspect the hand of Siddharth, Saurabh's boss, behind the murders.

videos.title: Qatil K. D.  Part 1
videos.overview: K.D. witnesses a girl committing suicide- K.D. and Varun are on their way to work , when young girl, severely injured runs into their car. She claims that she is being hunted by a 'red dog' , who has spared no one. When K.D. tries to reach out to help her, she runs in the opposite direction & is run-over & killed by another car. Who is she? Why was she so terrified of the 'red dog'? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Qatil K. D.  Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak claims that Varun's killer was hiding in the library after the murder took place. But, KD fails to conclusively prove his innocence. The court delivers the judgment and holds KD guilty of murder. The case takes a turn when inspector Dave brings a key witness to the court. Sanjay, a watchman at the library, helps prove KD's innocence. Then, KD calls Seema, a journalist, to the witness box and claims that she is behind the murders.

videos.title: Murder On 15th August Part 1
videos.overview: During the flag hoisting ceremony on the 15th of August, a politician is shot by a sniper. The politician survives as the bullet hits his arm. Then, Subhangi, who wants to marry Roshan, the politician's son, meets him while he is being treated. The politician and Subhangi have an argument, during which the politician suddenly feels breathless and dies. Subhangi is suspected of having murdered him and is arrested. Then, Subhangi's brother meets KD Pathak and persuades him to fight the case. During the courtroom proceedings, the prosecution lawyer proves that Subhangi has anger management issues. As Subhangi was upset with the politician for not letting her marry Roshan, the prosecution lawyer claims that Subhangi murdered the politician. With all the evidence pointing towards Subhangi, will KD Pathak be able to prove her innocence?

videos.title: Murder On 15th August Part 2
videos.overview: During the trial of Shubhangi for the murder of the politician Hridaynath, Pandey - the politician's personal assistant - informs that Shubhangi was called to the flag hoisting ceremony by Hridaynath. The case takes a surprising turn as Shubhangi claims that she killed Hridaynath. But, KD Pathak dismisses his client's statement. He produces Jayant, a prime suspect in the case, before the court. Jayant confesses that he shot Hridaynath but had no intention to kill him. Then, KD Pathak suspects that Dharam Veer, Hridaynath's father, conspired to kill his son.

videos.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 1
videos.overview: Prabhakar, a scientist, has invented a formula that makes a person invisible. Shortly before Prabhakar is to reveal it to the press, he is found dead in the laboratory. His assistant, Omi, is accused of murdering him and is arrested. Omi's fiancé, Kavita, persuades KD Pathak to represent Omi. During the courtroom proceedings, inspector Rathore reveals that Mohit had entered the laboratory on the day of Prabhakar's murder but has been missing ever since. Did Mohit steal the formula and murder Prabhakar? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Adrushya Qatil Part 2
videos.overview: Mohit, who has consumed Prabhakar's invisibility potion, is apprehended by KD Pathak. Mohit appears in court as a witness for KD. Rajnath Salgaonkar, the prosecutor's attorney, would not take his testimony, though. Nevertheless, Mohit is given the opportunity to speak, and he admits that he did not witness Prabhakar's killer. KD then devises a scheme to apprehend the offender. After assisting Mohit in escaping from detention, he orders Kunal, the main suspect in the case, to be attacked.

videos.title: Bandh Kamre Ka Raaz Part 1
videos.overview: Aniket, a film director, is making a biopic on underworld don Babu Bhai. After a while, Anikhet gets a death threat from Babu Bhai, and is subsequently found dead. His younger brother, Anuksh, who is mentally challenged, is accused of his murder and is arrested. KD Pathak hears about the case and decides to prove that Anuksh is innocent. Will KD Pathak win this case against all odds? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Bandh Kamre Ke Raaz Part 2
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak is threatened by a shooter working for Babu Bhai to recuse himself from the Ankit Mehra murder case. Pathak refuses and helps the cops to nab the shooter, disguised as a journalist. Meanwhile, the finding of a refrigerator that does not work in a panic room baffles the cops and the lawyers. Only three people had been in and out of Ankit Mehra’s house on the night of the murder. Will K.D. Pathak succeed in finding the real assailant among them?

videos.title: Zehreela Shadyantra Part 1
videos.overview: A famous fashion designer, Rocky Nath, is murdered at his own birthday party. Later, the police find that he was injected with a poison called procydin. The police suspect that Rocky’s fiancé Deepa is involved, as she is a chemist. The case goes to court and Deepa’s father, Mr. Bhushan, appoints K. D. Pathak as his lawyer. I. M. Jaiswal is the prosecuting lawyer and calls-in various witnesses to prove Deepa the killer. Later, it is found that the poison was prepared in his factory.

videos.title: Zehreela Shadyantra Part 2
videos.overview: Deepa’s father assures K.D. Pathak this daughter did not kill Rocky. During the courtroom proceedings, K.D. Pathak calls Namitha to the witness box. Namitha admits that she did administer an injection to Rocky but it did not contain a lethal solution. It comes to light that Siddharth had ordered Namitha to administer the injection. Questioned, Siddharth pleads his innocence. Later, while watching the footage of Rocky's birthday party, K.D. Pathak learns that the poison entered Rocky's bloodstream through the fumes from the candle. During the court hearing, K.D. Pathak calls Sudarshan Malik, a doctor, to the witness box. Did Sudarshan have a hand in Rocky’s murder?

videos.title: Alien Attack Part 1
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak learns that a UFO has been spotted in Wardhapur, Maharashtra. K.D. Pathak also learns that Chandu, a resident of Wardhapur. was attacked by aliens. Meanwhile, Chandu finds Steven's dead body near the UFO’s landing site in the forest. The police arrest him for Steven's murder. K.D. Pathak believes that Chandu is innocent and decides to represent him in the court. During the courtroom proceedings, Chandu claims that the aliens killed Steven. Will K.D. Pathak be able to prove Chandu’s innocence?

videos.title: Alien Attack Part 2
videos.overview: K.D Pathak and his team is in search of an alien who is spreading fear in the city. The alien pays K.D at his hotel but K.D is unfazed by it. Now the suspicion falls on Steven's brother, Tyler. Stay tuned to find out more.

videos.title: Khoonkhar Parindey Part 1
videos.overview: Hiren, after spending ten years in a mental asylum, is brought home. He was declared mentally unstable after being accused of murdering his family. Hiren once again finds himself in a tough spot as he is blamed for the murder of Supriya and Rupak. K.D. Pathak, convinced that Hiren is innocent, decides to represent him in the court. His adversary, Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, proves that Hiren has anger-management issues, and he was the killer of Supriya and Rupak. Then, Jaiswal produces a key witness, Surveen, who claims that Hiren is pretending to be mentally unstable. The case takes a twist when Surveen is found dead; and Hiren stands accused of his murder as well.

videos.title: Khoonkhar Parindey Part 2
videos.overview: While trying to gather evidence, K.D. Pathak is attacked by a colony of bats. He goes inside a cave to investigate and finds that someone has been feeding the bats. Then, K.D. Pathak hands over the food samples collected from the cave to a forensic doctor. The doctor informs K.D. Pathak that he found traces of three different chemical substances in the food. K.D. Pathak proves that the culprit trained the bats to attack a person who has been sprayed with the pheromones. With the culprit having meticulously planned the murders, can K.D. Pathak find him and prove that Hiren is innocent?

videos.title: Yeti Ka Hamla Part 1
videos.overview: A mountain climber, Aakash Kaul, allegedly spots a Yeti, an imaginary being said to inhabit the Himalayas. Two years later, accompanied by fellow climbers, he goes on an expedition called ‘Operation Yeti’ to confirm his suspicion. However, he is murdered and Vicky Mathur, fellow climber, is accused of the crime. K.D. Pathak finds this story on the news and on his assistant’s request decides to represent Vicky in court. In court, Vicky claims that he witnessed a Yeti kill Aakash. Will K.D. Pathak be able to prove Vicky’s innocence in court?

videos.title: Yeti Ka Hamla Part 2
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak receives a CD in the mail and finds a video with the Yeti captured on camera. The next day, he presents it as evidence in court and calls on witnesses to justify it. However, failing to prove its authenticity, he decides to visit the Himalayas in search of the Yeti. The prosecuting lawyer, Anjali Puri, decides to accompany him to ensure there is no bias. Meanwhile, the police find an encrypted mail on the victim Aakash Kaul’s laptop. Will K.D. Pathak find the Yeti and prove Vicky’s innocence in court?

videos.title: Adrushya Maa Part 1
videos.overview: The police rescue two young girls from an abandoned cottage in the forest and hand them over to Sarita Gupta, a counsellor. On investigating, they learn that the girls are sisters, Anuradha and Aanchal Patil, who went missing four years ago. The girls’ step father, Suresh, learns about this and decides to kill the sisters. However, he is murdered and Anuradha is accused of the crime. Sarita brings the case to K.D. Pathak and he learns that Suresh was killed by his wife who died 4 years ago.

videos.title: Adrushya Maa Part 2
videos.overview: Bhagwat, a paranormal researcher, informs K.D. Pathak that the spirit of Anuradha's mother killed her father and claims to prove it before the court. Then, Bhagwat meets Anuradha in the jail. Anuradha seems to be possessed by her mother's spirit and tries to attack Bhagwat. Later, during the courtroom proceedings, K.D. Pathak proves that Anuradha is acting possessed. Is Anuradha the culprit and has she been pretending to be possessed all along?

videos.title: Qatil Makkhi Part 1
videos.overview: Nayyar is accused of murdering his personal doctor. He claims in the court that the doctor was forced to jump off the balcony by a housefly. Ramesh Shukla, who is a staff at the doctor's clinic, claims that Nayyar pushed the doctor from the balcony. Inder Mohan Jaiswal, the prosecution lawyer, proves that Nayyar has fear of needles and injections. Jaiswal points out that while the doctor was trying to administer an injection to Nayyar, he was inadvertently pushed by Nayyar. Later, K.D. Pathak, who is representing Nayyar, learns of two deaths, which are unrelated to the case. Surprisingly, two people have lost their lives after seeing a housefly. How is the housefly related to the murder case?

videos.title: Qatil Makkhi Part 2
videos.overview: When a woman encounters K.D. Pathak, she tells him that Sanjana is a housefly in her second life. She discloses that as the train was moving, Sanjana was molested. Sanjana attempted to jump off the train and perished in the process. Later, Sunder Shah and Mohit Patel—who had molested Sanjana—are taken into custody by the police. Sunder passes away while in detention, and Mohit says a housefly killed him. K.D. Pathak provides evidence in court that the housefly is robotic. Now that the reincarnation concept has been debunked, K.D. Pathak is going to reveal who the murderer is.

videos.title: Electric Man Part 1
videos.overview: Inspector Dave apprehends Kapil, suspecting him to be responsible for the mysterious deaths at a store. Kapil has the ability to withstand high voltage and is even know to conduct electricity. Dave informs K.D. Pathak about Kapil and claims that he is the murderer. K.D. Pathak believes that Kapil is innocent and decides to represent him in the court. How is Kapil's superhuman ability related to the mysterious deaths?

videos.title: Electric Man Part 2
videos.overview: K.D. Pathak and Inspector Dave find a charred body inside a car. Dave suspects that Kapil, who has escaped from police custody, is responsible for the death. The police arrest Kapil and produce him before the court. During the courtroom proceedings, Kapil inadvertently hits the prosecution lawyer and he collapses on the floor. Later, K.D. Pathak is badly injured after being attacked by a person, who also possesses the ability to conduct electricity. After the attack, K.D. Pathak is almost certain that someone else, and not Kapil, is responsible for the crimes. But, with the culprit proving to be near impossible to catch, can K.D. Pathak capture him with the help of the police?

videos.title: Kissa Khoi Yaddasht Ka Part 1
videos.overview: A famous actress is murdered and the very next day a mysterious man stumbles into K.D. Pathak’s office claiming that he did not murder his wife. The man is behaving weirdly and keeps pictures of important things, people and locations. He also suffers from short-term memory loss, but has done some work in investigating his wife’s murder. K.D. Pathak decides to take up his case, feeling that he is innocent. Is the man with no memory really innocent or is he trying to cover up a heinous crime?

videos.title: Kissa Khoi Yaddasht Ka Part 2
videos.overview: Alok suffers another episode of memory loss in the court, and he asks K.D. Pathak to withdraw from the case as he still believes that he might have killed his wife. Meanwhile, K.D. Pathak proves in the court that Sonali has written the love letter to Alok after Shefali’s death, she stole Shefali’s ring, and that she has no love relation with Alok. The mystery further deepens as K.D. Pathak finds out that Shefali and Ritwik were in the same place when the latter was murdered.

videos.title: Aadamkhor Ped
videos.overview: A mad scientist Doctor Bhaskaran is thrilled by the outcome of his research and experiments on a carnivorous plant. He calls his assistant Avantika to his lab late in the night to share with her the recent development. He asks her to conduct DNA tests on a carnivorous plant as he goes out of his lab after the door bell rings. On his return, he is shocked to find Avantika dead and entangled by twigs and branches.

videos.title: Kaal Ka Haiwaan Part 1
videos.overview: After a lot of complaints of human shrieks and screams coming from a house in the jungle, police raid the place and find a lot of human remains. They arrest a man whom they suspect to be a cannibal. Meanwhile, K.D. Pathak remembers Varun, who had passed away four months back, on his birthday in his office. However, when he sees the picture of the cannibal on a news channel, K.D. Pathak is adamant that the man in question is none other than Varun.

videos.title: Kaal Ka Haiwaan Part 2
videos.overview: KD Pathak's assistant meets a doctor to inquire him about Varun. Then, the doctor is bitten by a venomous snake and breathes his last. An unknown assailant attacks KD Pathak's assistant. Later, KD Pathak meets Varun in the prison. Meanwhile, KD Pathak's assistant learns that Varun's death was a deception and Varun is still alive. What is the mystery behind Varun's mental distress and his supposed death? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Horror Hospital Part 1
videos.overview: Dr. Sandhya is being sued for the murder of Babulaal, a patient she had operated on to remove kidney stones. Moreover, post-mortem records state that Babulaal's kidneys and urine tube were severed during surgery, which is how he passed away. In spite of all the evidence to the contrary, Dr. Sandhya maintains her innocence. Seeing as how everyone is trying to get her fired, she turns to K.D. Pathak for assistance.

videos.title: Horror Hospital Part 2
videos.overview: Sharman panics after seeing a dead body walking in the morgue, however, it is later revealed as Varun, who was hiding from Dr. Bhagwat. Later, Varun uncovers a kidney in an icebox which was placed inside a refrigerator inside Dr. Bhagwat's office. K.D. Pathak presents this discovery in the court to support his claim that a racket of acquiring and selling kidneys of poor patients is being run at the Satyavati Hospital.

videos.title: Bhootiya Hostel Part 1
videos.overview: Mugdha Shetty goes to a college for shooting a horror documentary along with four others. Something goes wrong during the shoot and Mugdha manages to escape from the place. She comes home to Vikas and tries to explain that she had a paranormal experience in that place. Meanwhile, the police arrest her for murder. Mugdha and her husband approach Mr. Phatak. In the court, Mugdha explains the events that took place in the college but the prosecutor accuses her of being the murderer because of her split personality disorder. Phatak thinks that maybe Mugdha is telling the truth and hence decides to send his assistants to check if the college is really haunted.

videos.title: Bhootiya Hostel Part 2
videos.overview: Mr.Phatak produces Mugdha's medical report to the court and says that nothing is wrong with the medical condition. The court has a special guest who explains what actually happened in the college. the watchman of the college experiences a paranormal activity and approaches the police for help. Phatak's assistants go back to inspect the college and catch the culprit.The next day at the court, after the prosecution of a few members related to the case, the judge comes to a conclusion.

videos.title: Bhootiya Bungalow
videos.overview: A family moves into their new home. The mother and daughter notice strange activity around the house. One night, the mother murders the father while their daughter witnesses the crime. The mother is imprisoned and her brother reaches out to K.D. Pathak to prove her innocence in court. The daughter, in her testimony, believes that her mother was possessed by a spirit which forced her to commit the crime. However, K.D. Pathak refuses to believe her theory but accepts the challenge.

videos.title: Raakh Ka Adi Manav Part 1
videos.overview: Arriving in K.D Pathak's office from Bihar, a man named Sarju is in dire need of his assistance. The man confesses that the villagers have been tormented by a monster called Rakesh ever since his grandma passed away. The village priest claims that burning down Sarju's agricultural field—where the demon appears to have taken up residence—is the only way to drive out this monster. This has been approved by the village sarpanch, and Sarju is now hoping that K.D. Pathak can assist him in preserving his crops.

videos.title: Raakh Ka Adi Manav Part 2
videos.overview: After finding the dead body of Paltan in Sarju's field, along with his sickle, the police arrests Sarju, who pleads innocence. To K.D. Pathak's surprise, the dead body was cremated before a post-mortem could be conducted. However, K.D. Pathak has an ace up his sleeves as he introduces a new evidence in the court. Will K.D. Pathak be able to save Sarju? Who is the man behind Rakash the demon?

videos.title: Qatil Pilot Part 1
videos.overview: There are rumors of a deceased fighter pilot’s ghost haunting the Jaisalmer airspace. A man with a phobia for flying takes K.D. Pathak’s seat in the business class to rest. The man later complains of seeing a ghost pilot through his window. The young politician who is next to him disagrees and mocks him. Meanwhile, the pilots wonder why it is foggy when it is supposed to be a clear night. Then, the man with the phobia finds himself holding a knife. When K.D. Pathak walks in, he finds the politician dead in his seat, with bloodstains on the knife the man is holding. Will K.D. Pathak be able to solve this scary case?

videos.title: Qatil Pilot Part 2
videos.overview: Pilots who were heading towards Jaisalmer airspace shocked to see the ghost of a deceased fighter Pilot. K.D. Pathak questions Pilot Soham about the Rum that was found in Airplane's Toilet. The court also finds out that one of the flight attendants mixed a certain drug that made anyone who consumed it to hallucinate. K.D. Pathak gets to know about a love triangle. Will K.D. Pathak and his Assistants be able to see the fighter Pilot?

videos.title: Rakht Pisach Part 1
videos.overview: Promoolving around KD Pathak, a  suave, sophisticated, witty and yet unconventional lawyer who is known as a 'Houdini' in circles of law because he can get his clients out of the tightest of situations. His success rate of acquittals is 100 percent. But most importantly KD stands not for his client, but for Justice.

videos.title: Rakht Pisach Part 2
videos.overview: K.D. Phatak loses one of his assistants during the investigation. He goes to the police station and asks for help but the police refuses to register a complaint before 24 hours. The next day, a panchayat takes place in order to decide what punishment should be given to Chandrika. In this meeting, Gauri, Tantrik baba and other members of the village are questioned. K.D. Pathak then decides to go to the jungle himself to see the mysterious creature. He calls the A.C.P for assistance. Will K.D. Phatak find the creature?

videos.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 1
videos.overview: The sight of a head with a parachute attached plummeting from the sky startles the locals. The doctor informs the police that the head is artificial following forensic investigation. The doctor also notices PK's symbol behind the face. The discovery of a dead body that resembled the face that had fallen from the sky gives the authorities still more shock. Parivartan Kumar, a well-known sculptor, is detained. K.D. Pathak chooses to take up Parivartan Kumar's legal battle. Is Jindal a part of this murder? Will K.D. catch Aadesh Chaudhary and Mansookh Kumar's killer. Pathak?

videos.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 2
videos.overview: When Parivarthak Kumar is arrested once again for the murder of two people from the city, K.D. Pathak questions him about the incident. Upon his inquiry, Parivarthak reveals to him that he was at the scene of the crime because of a call he had received from Pathak himself. Shocked, Pathak states that he never made such a call and realises that his client is being framed. As he continues to investigate the matter and defend his client, they draw nearer to finding the real perpetrator.

videos.title: Jaadui Shakti Ka Rahasya Part 1
videos.overview: A famous magician seeks help from his former guru to expand his powers of telekinesis. His guru however, refuses to help him because of his self-centred behaviour in the past. He however agrees later, when the magician offers a generous donation to the 'Ashram'.
