The fact that only Samar had the key to the van door raises suspicion that probably he helped Bilawal to escape. The mystery of how Bilawal escaped in the bracket of 3 minutes from a high security police van running at a speed of 80 km/hr is bugging KD. In the cloud of doubts & mystery how will KD be able to bring back honour to Samar and restore the faith of a freedom fighter on the Independence day?

videos.title: Room No 666 Ka Rahasya: Part 1
videos.overview: A movie producer is murdered under strange circumstances in his hotel room. The prime suspect in the case is a writer who was reportedly involved in an altercation with the victim prior to his death. When K.D.Pathak is assigned the case, he learns that the suspect had seen a woman set the victim on fire and push him off the building. However, the waiter, who was an eyewitness, claimed otherwise. Was he lying or does this involve the paranormal?

videos.title: Room No 666 Ka Rahasya: Part 2
videos.overview: Publisher Zubin reveals in the court that Manav had narrated a story which was similar to Rajiv's death. K.D. Pathak questions Zubin about Rajiv's death. A shocking footage is revealed in the court. What had happened 5 years back in room no 666?

videos.title: Murde Ki Hatya Ka Rahshya
videos.overview: A man is arrested by the police for digging up graves and mutilating their bodies with an axe. On interrogation, the police find that the suspect had dreamt about his brother being dead and was following his orders, received in the said dream, to kill those people.

videos.title: Badla Pichhle Janam Ka
videos.overview: Vaidik is accused of his father’s death who fell from the terrace. Vaidik tells KD he didn't do it. His father wasn't well so he took his father out to the terrace for some fresh air but did not kill him. However, a video by the prosecution presents shocks everyone. It was shot from the opposite terrace where two girls were recording themselves but in the background, Vaidik is clearly seen pushing his father from the terrace. KD is taken aback. All of a sudden Vaidik accepts that he killed his father but claims that a mystical voice commanded him to do so. The prosecution ridicules this but a psychiatrist upholds Vaidik’s claim. Nityanand would often dream of being on a battlefield and killing an unarmed soldier who he realized was his son from the present life. Vaidik too dreamt the same dream time and again. How can two people dream two halves of the same dream?

videos.title: Killer Guitar: Part 1
videos.overview: Andy, the bass guitarist of a rock band is accused of the murder of his band member Ryan. Andy being Varun’s cousin, KD Pathak takes up the case. Andy is confident that he will be acquitted, as he knows he has done nothing wrong. To everyone's surprise, Andy is free in the initial trial itself, not just because of lack of evidence but also because the witness that Jaiswal had presented admits to giving a false statement against Andy owing to Jaiswal pressurizing him. Andy is not even thankful to KD. KD starts to play the cursed guitar. What will happen now? Will KD be able to save himself from the curse? Watch to find out.

videos.title: Killer Guitar: Part 2
videos.overview: The story takes a twist when Zack who was to replace Andy in the group is murdered. Andy is scared and approaches. As the trial ensues, Kamat the manager of the band claims that it's not Andy but the guitar that the victims played and the tune that killed them. To debunk the ‘Cursed Guitar Theory’, Jaiswal asks if anyone would like to play it and one of the people in the court does. Surprisingly, he is murdered too. This shocks everyone. KD smells foul play. Determined to end the outrageous claim, KD eventually himself plays the tune on the guitar in the court. Is KD going to get murdered too?

videos.title: Gawah Ya Khooni
videos.overview: A Case where a man who lost his memory is found with a novel in hand and lodged in the novel is a bullet. Meanwhile, the cops find the body of a famous Art Dealer in an art gallery. Riddled with 4 bullets, they find five bullet casings around him and realize a fifth bullet was fired but is missing. The two stories connect and before you know it, the cops feel this Amnesiac Man who has a signature beginning with K, is the only link/witness to the murder of the art dealer. The shooter fired at the Art Dealer and one bullet missed and hit this man’s novel.  And this leads to an intricate web of Fake Paintings, Forgeries, Omani Sheikhs and dubious painters who all end up being under the needle of suspicion.

videos.title: Deewana Qatil: Part 1
videos.overview: The case of a man, Baalam, who claims to love an actress. But he is upset with her as she is married to a businessman. He gives threatening calls to her as she broke his heart. A day later, the actress is found dead with the film reel wrapped around her body. Clearly, the culprit is  Baalam. KD takes up the case as his mother tells him the reason behind his madness for actresses. He had lost his love some years back.

videos.title: Deewana Qatil: Part 2
videos.overview: Baalam has now found another actress to be mad for, Barkha but there is news that she also is about to get married. He manages to escape from prison and when found, he has the dead body of Barkha lying by his side. The case is complicated when he starts blackmailing KD to get the autograph of an actress, which when KD refuses, Baalam publically confesses that he murdered both the actresses.

videos.title: Ek Khoon Char Aaropi
videos.overview: Four men in a Sauna with their boss, the owner of the company. One of them is involved in a 15 crore scam which the boss is about to get to know. They had four props a book, a flask, a cell phone and an iPod. Neither is a weapon.  But when the mist of the Sauna clears, the boss is killed with a deep wound impaling his neck.  Only one of the other four could have done it. The cops do their research and arrest Roshan, who is involved in the scam.  But KD feels otherwise.

videos.title: Amnesiac husband: Part 1
videos.overview: A car with a couple meets with an accident. The husband undergoes a face surgery as it is badly scarred. Also, his memory is lost. After the husband’s face is healed completely, he is taken under arrest on account of drinking and driving. KD takes this case up as the wife and everyone around tells him that the husband never used to drink. The case escalates when it is found that wife had an extramarital affair with a man called Rajat, who is also missing since the same day they met with the accident. The troubles deepen for the husband and story takes a turn when Rajat’s body is found, but everyone is shocked to see that it has the same face as the husband. How would KD crack the case?

videos.title: Amnesiac husband: Part 2
videos.overview: Kabir is accused of murdering Rajat. K.D. Pathak decides to fight the case and tries all possible ways to save Kabir. The case escalates when it is found that wife had an extra marital affair with a man called Rajat, who is also missing since the same day they met with the accident. The troubles deepen for the husband and story takes a turn when Rajat’s body is found, but everyone is shocked to see that it has the same face as the husband.

videos.title: The Challenger
videos.overview: A man is accused of setting his cottage on fire with his wife and child inside. A stranger walks into K.D Phatak's office and confesses that she started the fire in the cottage. She further continues to challenge K.D Phatak to prove her guilty in the court. K.D Phatak decides to take the case up but finds clear evidence for the suspect to be at fault. He further finds out that the suspect was involved in a marital affair with Dimple, who challenged K.D Phatak portraying to be Avni. Who is the real culprit?

videos.title: Nausikhiya Chor ya Beraham Qatil
videos.overview: When K.D Phatak decides to arrange something for Binnymore's birthday, he receives a call from her saying she is at the police station.When he arrives at the police station, he sees her yelling at an officer asking him to release the boy, Pinchu, who she claims to be innocent. At the court, the prosecutor assumes this to be a case of mercy killing but, K.D Phatak thinks otherwise. K.D Phatak continues his investigation to find out that Pinchu has selective Kleptomania.

videos.title: Murder In Lift
videos.overview: Amathya Patel, a person suffering from Meningnitis is accused of murdering his step-father, Sameer Prasad in the lift. K.D Phatak takes up the case and decides to fight for Amathya as he thinks there was another person present in the lift apart from Amathya and Sameer. At first, the guard of the building is questioned. Later, Natwar the financer and Alex the stuntman are questioned. Who is the killer? Will K.D Phatak solve the case?

videos.title: Pran Jaye Par Vachan Na Jaye
videos.overview: The night watchman of Nirmal Heights Apartments finds drops of blood on the ground. When he follows the trail, he finds Joginder Kukreja dead body in the car. The police arrest Devika for the murder as she confesses her crime. But the police inspector feels otherwise about her as she is old. He calls K.D Phatak and advises him to take up the case. Devika is certain of not taking help from anyone. What happens to Devika?

videos.title: Death of a Super Hero Part 1
videos.overview: Gagan, the hero of the serial 'Suryaman' falls off a building during a shoot and dies. Jamshed, the stunts coordinator gets arrested for the murder of the actor. K.D Phatak takes up Jamshed's case and decides to fight for him. Meanwhile, Gagan's daughter thinks that her stepmother is the reason for the death of her father.

videos.title: Death of a Super Hero Part 2
videos.overview: K.D Phatak continues to fight for Jamshed, the stuntman of Gagan. He calls Hiren, Gagan's lawyer in the witness box for questioning. At the same time, K.D Phatak learns that Gagan's makeup artist has been killed the exact same way he was killed. As Hiren starts answering the questions asked, he mentions about Gagan's broken marriage and his plan to divorce his wife.

videos.title: Shakhchunni: Part 2
videos.overview: Ashi a village girl gets married to Dishant. Unhappy with his marriage, Dishant decides to sleep separately. One night, he sees his wife jumping from the terrace. But, when he checks the room, he sees her sleeping soundly. Dishant reaches for K.D Phatak's help and explains this issue. The prosecutor accuses Dishant.

videos.title: Shakhchunni: Part 2
videos.overview: As K.D Phatak continues to dig deeper into the case, he starts to suspect more people. He figures out that the dupatta with Radha's name on it had no burnt marks or any other damage on it; hence, coming to a conclusion that it was a remake. Meanwhile, he stops the baba from cutting down all the mango trees assuming that Radha's soul is trapped in it. Next day at the court, he proves that Ashi was a victim of a certain mental disorder.

videos.title: Kadghare Mein Judge
videos.overview: Maushir Masalawala gets a sentence of six months in prison for stealing. Shruti, his girlfriend is disheartened and tells him that she's disappointed with him. She further says that their marriage wouldn't be approved by their family as the judge who punished him is her uncle. As days passed, Shruti is excited to be a part of her sister's wedding. While going to help the bride to get ready, Maushir calls her, asking her about their baby. Unfortunately, Justice Chand, Shruti's uncle hears this conversation. Later, everyone in the family finds Shruti dead and are shocked.

videos.title: Diwali Special
videos.overview: Inspector Dave calls K.D Phatak to inform him that he wouldn't be coming for dinner because he has to take a look at a murder case. K.D Phatak gets curious to find out about the case and meets Vivek Dara. Vivek Dara is the youngest son of Pitambar Dara and is accused of killing his own father. K.D Phatak decides to help Vivek and takes up his case only to find out that their family was a big mess as none of the siblings liked each other.

videos.title: Bolta Puppet
videos.overview: Ankita Vora's sister finds her at the edge of a cliff holding a knife. She runs to grab her thinking she is going to commit suicide. Soon, she learned that a puppet Anish, Ankita's husband had, had encouraged her to kill her husband. K.D Phatak receives a call from the talking puppet saying that it had murdered Anish. The puppet introduces itself as Harry and video calls K.D Phatak as a proof. K.D Phatak meets Anita and realizes that she is in shock from seeing her husband die. How will K.D Phatak find the culprit?

videos.title: Murder at Play
videos.overview: K.D Phatak and his team go to watch a play. During the play, they notice that Manas, the actor in lead role is on the ground with a knife pierced through his stomach. While the audience thinks it is method acting, they soon realize that he has actually been injured. Zenia, the actress in lead role gets arrested for the murder as she was the only person on stage with Manas.

videos.title: KD Aur Aatma Ka Rahasya
videos.overview: While K.D Phatak is at a newsstand buying a newspaper, a strange thing happens to him. He meets a man named Jayant Kirani and starts talking to him about a certain case. Jayant says that a person has murdered the previous night and his wife, Shivani is seen as a major suspect and is arrested. Before going back, he mentions that the person who was murdered was himself. The newspaper seller calls out the K.D. Phatak asking who he was talking to as there was no one around them. The same incident happens that night with K.D as Jayant provides K.D with a clue.

videos.title: Swami Ji Ka Qatil
videos.overview: Krishna, a disciple of Satyanand is spotted holding a tiki torch and heading towards the pharmacy to destroy the medicines. when another disciple follows him, trying to stop him but seconds later sees the pharmacy on fire. He further notices that Satyanand guruji was still inside the room and is now stuck in a burning room. Krishna gets arrested and is accused of attempt to murder. Satyanand says that he saw Krishna start the fire. The next day, Krishna's mother reaches for K.D Phatak's help and asks him to take the case. How will K.D Phatak be able to help Krishna?

videos.title: Mrs. Billimoria Ka Case
videos.overview: Billy is celebrating her uncle Rustom's birthday at his house. As the clock strikes 12, Rustom says that he has found out a dirty secret of one of his family members and will reveal it the following day in front of h9is friend, ACP Raud.  That night, Rustom sees someone in a yellow raincoat trying to strangle him. He pushes the glass of water as a sign, creating noise loud enough for his son to rush into his room. Unfortunately, by then the culpirt escapes. The next day, Billy gets arrested. K.D.Phatak for help.

videos.title: Anokhi Chunauti
videos.overview: Radhe, K.D Phatak's cook is on the phone with K.D Phatak as he hears a knock on the door. He cuts the call in order to attend the door but, doesn't find anyone at the door. He opens the door wondering who it might be as it is pretty late but, to his shock, someone swings a sickle at him. Garuda gets arrested for Radhe's murder. K.D Phatak meets Garuda to tell him that he will be fighting against him to acquire peace to Radhe's soul. But, to his shock, Garuda warns him saying that the court needs proof for everything and he's managed to destroy all the proof.

videos.title: KD and the Crazies
videos.overview: One night at Shanti Nivas, a mental asylum, a man is found murdered near one of the cells. The victim Tipu, was an attendant at the asylum, who had stolen a patient Drishti's necklace before he was murdered. When his partner finds his dead body, he sees a shivering Drishti sitting next to him with a bloody knife in her hand. The next morning, as Drishti is accused of murdering Tipu, the nurse at the asylum seeks K.D. Pathak's help, knowing that Drishti is innocent.

videos.title: Dayan
videos.overview: When three notorious girls are electrocuted to at a ladies' hostel compound, the residents in the hostel get worried. A few nights later, one of them, Namrata, manages to escape from the killer's grasp, and is rescued by the security and the other girls. When the hostel attendant, Mona arrives at the scene, Namrata is overcome with fear upon noticing that she resembled the killer. Mona is then accused of and is arrested, causing her to seek Pathak's help to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Murder  By Latter
videos.overview: Sanjeev Soni, a candidate for the position of Prime Minister in the upcoming elections, is accused of murdering his wife Bhoomika, who was found dead in a hotel suite one morning. Having read a confidential mail addressed to Sanjeev which implied that the latter was cheating on his wife, Bhoomika walked out on him on the day of her demise

videos.title: Shiv Ka Shraap Part 1
videos.overview: Sanjeev Soni, a candidate for the position of Prime Minister in the upcoming elections, is accused of murdering his wife Bhoomika, who was found dead in a hotel suite one morning. Having read a confidential mail addressed to Sanjeev which implied that the latter was cheating on his wife, Bhoomika walked out on him on the day of her demise. Suspecting foul play, K.D. Pathak resolves to fight for Sanjeev.

videos.title: Shiv Ka Shraap Part 2
videos.overview: A young man from Jharkhand by the name of Madhav, accuses the god Shiva of having murdered his dear friend Ashish Mitra. The extraordinary claim soon makes breaking news, which reaches the ears of K.D. Pathak. Unable to believe the young man's claims, Pathak decides to investigate the case. Unsure of the authenticity behind Madhav's claims, Pathak visits him in the hospital and learns from him the events of the murder. He then decides to find out the truth and expose the real killer.

videos.title: CID vs Adaalat Karmyudh
videos.overview: In this second episode of Adaalat; we will to know about the investigation of Meghna murder case. The allegation of murder is on Mahaguru Atyanand and team CID is thoroughly investigating all the details of the case. However, Team CID is made confused by a call from Megha’s number to the ACP. Want to know who is trying to confuse CID?

videos.title: Resin Attack
videos.overview: Aditi gets attacked by a few strangers in a white car while she was waiting for a bus. She gets hit by the car and falls in hot oil which was next to the bus station and burns her face. When the police question her, she tells them that she's sure that her ex Viraj was behind this heinous act. But the next day,  she goes back to the police station and withdraws her complaint. the next day, she gets attacked again and dies.

videos.title: Scare Crow
videos.overview: Gagan gets murdered in Kailash's fields and the entire village assumes that the trapped soul in one of the scarecrows in Kailash's fields killed him. Thakur, the village Mukhia bosses over Kailash and demands for his land saying the time period to pay is six months and not two years. Kailash and his wife reach K.D Phatak for help and mention about the scarecrow and the mysterious activities that have been taking place since the death of the Jakir Singh.

videos.title: Yaksh
videos.overview: Bacchu and Lakhan Singh go to Bhagmati lake to throw garbage. Lakhan decides to stay back and look after the truck as Bacchu goes to the lake to discard the garbage. Bacchu comes across a mysterious creature Yaksha, the protector of the environment. Terrified of what he had witnessed, Bacchu runs to inform Lakhan about the Yaksha but, Lakhan laughs at him which leads to an argument between the two; resulting in Lakhan leaving Bacchu at the disposal site. When he returns after some time, Lakhan finds Bacchu's dead body on the ground. Lakhan gets arrested for the murder and Lakhan's wife reaches for K.D Phatak's help. How will K.D solve this case?

videos.title: Outhouse Skeleton
videos.overview: Ranveer Ranjha, a pop star gets arrested for the murder of his manager Manish. K.D Pathak takes up Ranveer's case and tries to help him get out of the case. The prosecutor points out that Manish's dead body was found hidden and cemented in one of the walls of Ranveer's guest house. He further continues to say that the Police found a cricket bat which was used to murder Manish along with the body from the same place. How will K.D Phatak solve this tough case?

videos.title: Goa Mein Bhootia Car Part 1
videos.overview: In this episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a vintage car which has killed a youth named Savio on the roads of Goa. However, the eye witness of the incident has narrated to the investigating officers that there was no driver inside the haunted car and it was running on its own. Moreover, the owner of the car Mr. Jhilmil is arrested for killing Savio! Want to know more about the case? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

videos.title: Goa Mein Bhootia Car Part 2
videos.overview: In this episode of Adaalat, Sussane claims that the car is no longer buried under the ground and has escaped. She and her brother claim that the car is now possessed by the ghost of their father and is out for revenge. The four friends Mark, David, Savio and Nikhil were after the car as it is vintage and there are five such cars in the world. They tried to intimidate their father by vandalizing the car that gave James a heart attack. Will the car get revenge? Or is there something else to this case?

videos.title: Lohri Special
videos.overview: Amanpreet and Sarabjeet elope from their respective homes to start a new life together. Before taking any decision on their own, they meet with K.D Phatak. The couple tells K.D Phatak that they have left their family to start a life together and further explain about their families' rivalry. K.D says that he would take up their case if only they return to their house. He decides to meet Sarabjeet's uncle in prison to find out more about how the conflicts between the families started.

videos.title: Murder Sankrati
videos.overview: Urmi asks her husband Ankit to stop flying the kite and get ready as they had to go visit her mother and the rest of her family. but, Ankit says that he is least interested to visit them as he is treated as a servant rather than a son-in-law. After reaching their house, Jignesh, Urmi's brother collects a bag of medicines from Ankit and walks away. Seeing this, Ankit says that he hates Jignesh and wishes to see him dead. Minutes later, everyone in the house hears a huge explosion in the terrace. When they rush to see what caused the explosion, they see Jignesh on fire. Suresh and Ankit become the prime suspects. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: The Terrorist Part 1
videos.overview: Latif, a demolition worker gets caught in Mumbai with a bag containing bombs and explosives. The media says that he was trying to demolish a wall behind an army school near by. Latif's mother visits K.D. Phatak and tells him that someone has tricked her son into this and he is innocent. K.D. Phatak agrees to take up the case and make sure he acquires justice.

videos.title: The Terrorist Part 2
videos.overview: Latif, a demolition worker gets caught in Mumbai with a bag containing bombs and explosives. The media says that he was trying to demolish a wall behind an army school near by. Latif's mother visits K.D. Phatak and tells him that someone has tricked her son into this and he is innocent. K.D. Phatak agrees to take up the case and make sure he acquires justice.

videos.title: Hunch Back
videos.overview: Akash has invited his friend on a dinner and it was then Akash’s wife Sonia got brutally murdered. However, now the blame of murder is on Ronak but he is pleading before KD Pathak that he is trapped in this case and wants justice! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

videos.title: The Evil Twin
videos.overview: A man watching a horror film in his apartment witnesses a murder in the house opposite to him and calls the police. When the police find Sudeep dead on the floor, they see his girlfriend crying next to the corpse. Sudeep's girlfriend gets blamed for the murder and gets arrested.

videos.title: Haunted House Part 1
videos.overview: Vibhur, Aditi, and his family move into a new mansion in a jungle. As they move in, they start noticing weird activities taking place around them. Vibhur hears some noise from the bathroom of his house and goes to check. He finds the realtor fixing a rusted tap and freaks out. Later, Aditi notices the rude behavior of her neighbor and mentions it to her husband. That night, Vibhur attempts to shoot his stepson but ends up killing the old lady. how will K.D Phatak help Vibhur out?

videos.title: Haunted House Part 2
videos.overview: In this episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a double murder which has happened inside a haunted house. Mrs. Dilshad Mistry and Mr. Taneja is killed inside the haunted house which is approximately 100 years old structure. However, the allegation of murder is on KD Pathak’s client Mr. Vibhor Shetty! Can KD Pathak prove his client’s innocence before the honourable court?

videos.title: The Apartment Part 1
videos.overview: Karan sees two men carrying a heavy trunk into his neighbor's house. He notices that the trunk starts shaking in the elevator and freaks out. Later, he tells his friend about this and both of them decide to sneak into their house. After sneaking in, they witness the Divechas worshipping the demon and are shocked. The two friends go to the police to complain but, fail to show any proof.  The next day, they disguise themselves as electricians and hide a spy cam in the Divechas house. Afterward, when Karan doesn't show up, his friend takes it to the police himself. when the police watch the video, they see Karan being stabbed with a knife by his own friend. Karan's friend gets arrested and calls K.D Phatak for help.

videos.title: The Apartment Part 2
videos.overview: Chetan gets released from the prison but, to his misfortune,  more weird incidents start happening after his release. The Divechas find Karan's body and promise Chetan to bring him back to life.  Later, Inspector Dave finds Karan's dead body inChetan's house and arrests him. Raavi, a common friend of Karan and Chetan says that Chetan suffers from schizophrenia and just then, Chetan has an anxiety attack ad faints in the court room. Are the Divechas really the culprits or is Chetan delusional?

videos.title: The Chatroom Part 1
videos.overview: Payal gets arrested for the murder of her friend Keith. But, unfortunately, dies of an electric shock. K.D Phatak decides to become a member of the chat room and joins the social networking site. Later, Keith's sister gets a call from his friend asking for a favor.

videos.title: Bairagadh Ka Piscaach
videos.overview: Kinchuk Das, his friends Gagan Singh and Maadhav are on their way back to the city when they see a woman dressed as a bride and walking towards them in the jungle. They decide to help her out but soon, their car breaks down. They see an old building near by and decide to rest for some time. All of them notice cannibalistic behavior of the owner of the house during dinner. Later, Kinchuk Das is found dead and Kunwar is caught sucking blood out of Kinchuk's body. K.D Phatak decides to fight for Kunwar and take up his case. Is Kunwar a vampire?

videos.title: Bairaag Ka Pisaach
videos.overview: In Today’s episode of Adaalat; we will get to know that about the investigation of Kingshuk Das murder case and its proceedings in the court room. However, tonight we will get to know that in search of Shukmani; Inspector Dave; is held captive inside the haunted ancestral palace! Want to know more about the evil spirit angle associated with this case?

videos.title: The Auto Writer Part 1
videos.overview: In Today’s episode of Adaalat, we will get to know about a murder case of Justice Debabrata Shina’s son Bharghav. A lady named Yakshita Manjrekar has called up Justice Sinha to inform him that his son has reached to the world of spirits and doesn’t wants to return back from there. However, she claims that she is able to speak with him and he wants to inform her about his murderers! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

videos.title: The Auto Writer Part 2
videos.overview: The psychiatrist named Yakshita Manjrekar has convinced Bharghav’s mother that her son wants to communicate with her and she started teaching her the art of communicating with spirits. However, they both went on and informed KD Pathak about the hallucinating fact that they are able to communicate with deceased Bharghav but will KD believe on Yakshita’s theory in this case! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

videos.title: Jurassic Jazeera Part 1
videos.overview: In Today’s episode; we will get to know about a case where KD Pathak, inspector Dave and a famous businessman Mr. Walia were flying in a private Jet to Chandigarh. The pilot of the private jet has very dubiously took them to an isolated island where Dinosaurs are still found! Want to know the Pilot has done this? Want to know on whose orders the Pilot has put everyone’s life at stake? Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!

videos.title: Jurassic Jazeera Part 2
videos.overview: K.D gains the trust of the primitive jungle men by playing a voice recording. Meanwhile, inspector Dave and gang run towards the plane to escape from the T-Rex. Will the group successfully escape from the enormous creature? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Trikon the Magician Part 1
videos.overview: KD arrives with the police commissioner to enjoy a magic show. During the show, the magician's assistant disappears while a doctor who went missing 30 years ago, reappears. KD is informed by the comissioner that Dr Prakash had murdered another doctor and gone into hiding 30 years before. But KD is baffled by Dr Prakash's appearance, as he hasn't aged in all these years.

videos.title: Trikon the Magician Part 2
videos.overview: Vibha gets murdered in a storeroom and Trikon, the magician gets arrested for it. Later, K.D Phatak talks to a man who calls himself V-20 but, K.D Phatak learns that Dr.Prakash is the same person as V-20. Varun and Dave get caught in a fire. Will they be able to escape? Stay tuned to find out.

videos.title: Yamraj Qatil
videos.overview: In Today’s episode, we present to you a murder case of a young man named Arun; who is allegedly killed by Yamraaj. The prime suspect, in this case, is a Pedestrian named Dev; who is a drug addict.
